author: Ogrey
body:
Hey guys! This map is a sequel to my map, Formorgar, and it is, at the same time, an entry for Para's Map Contest by Slicorn & me.

Map Name: Formorgar II
Map Creators: Slicorn & Evocal
Server Provider: alexanderjoe10
Download Link: http://www.mediafire.com/download/bgr6cnbp5db26dx/Garlicbread.rar
YML Link: http://pastebin.com/Pv4hidef
Basic Info:
DTM (2 monuments)
Prospit vs Derse (Yellow vs Purple, 25 vs 25)
Enchantment Tables, like in Formorgar I
Iron Farms and a few Diamond Blocks, placed similarly to Formorgar I
Wide paths and corridors to navigate on
Pillars that provide light during night

Map Images:
